Golf Courses
East of Cleveland: Willoughby Hills, Chardon & Painesville

Explore five selections east of Cleveland, grouped by their distinct towns: Manakiki in Willoughby Hills, Fowler’s Mill in Chesterland, St. Denis and Pleasant Hill in Chardon, and Painesville Country Club in Painesville. Compare each location separately, then check the selected prices and booking options for your round.

5 selections from Tee Drop’s directory, not an exhaustive regional list. These are separate communities east of Cleveland, not five courses in Cleveland city.
